value.rationale: The dodecahedron is the canonical cubic planar girth-five graph. Exact agreement of unrestricted jumps with adjacency-restricted slides throughout the optimum location-domination layer is a structural statement of mobility not implied by minimum cardinality, global bounds, or generic reachability. Complete state, degree and distance profiles give a useful finite benchmark for constrained sensor relocation. The natural optimum object and two standard moves motivate the exact invariant; no arbitrary graph slice is introduced.
